basic_info.description: Huge Price Reduction! Stunning high floor view condo at Opera Plaza. Updated with beautiful finishes throughout. Amazing San Francisco views over greenery to Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower. Fabulous sunsets! Outstanding floor plan with dining area, private view balcony and generous closet space. Newer dual pane windows in bedroom with romantic window seat. Opera Plaza is a well managed complex with numerous amenities including 24 hour private security staff, on site management, heated pool and spa, concierge, fitness center, racquet courts and more! On-site optional leased parking. Best central San Francisco location is on transit line and close to freeways.
